newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$196.00/cubic metre, or C$31.16/barrel Cromer light sour C$189.00/cubic metre, or C$30.05/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$166.00/cubic metre, or C$26.39/barrel Midale at Cromer C$160.00/cubic metre, or C$25.44/barrel -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
